question.text: Deviation from the intended allocation at the time of order placement requires:

answer.text: Prior written approval of Principal Officer AND Compliance Officer with rationale
Approval of the client only after the trade

explanation.text: The Logic: Deviations must have prior written approval of PO + CO with detailed rationale. The Trap: Oral or post-facto approvals breach the fairness principle. Cross-Exam Context: Same control in III-A, III-C. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain an exception register; trend analysis often reveals recurring gaps.
